known_limitations: C1-W1: Task 1 does not scientifically resolve the primary early-TRE claim: ER-101 ended NO_SELECTION; the only grounded source is a secondary summary of a 12-to-8pm TRE RCT, so the core early-window intervention requirement remains uncovered.

C1-W2: Task 1 calorie/weight-independence remains NOT_ADDRESSED and the context route source was inaccessible. These unresolved states are correctly preserved and must not be upgraded in the final report.

C1-W3: Task 2 causal-isolation coverage is supported by a single source's design statement that other environmental parameters were strictly controlled; the abstract does not individually enumerate temperature/noise/humidity, and the dedicated ER-202 isolation route itself ended NO_SELECTION.

C1-W4: HO selection records generated in the same second reuse one selection_id within each task. Route-qualified files and append-only logs preserve the decisions, so no execution ambiguity occurred, but future gate tooling should make selection IDs route-qualified/unique.

C1-W5: NO_SELECTION selection artifacts do not carry the stop_artifact hash directly. The task STOP artifact and route-specific logs preserve traceability, but future tooling should bind NO_SELECTION records to the frozen STOP hash explicitly.

C1-W6: The full MAFS regression had one identity-guard failure caused by detached-HEAD gate posture; the same identity-guard tests passed 3/3 on a temporary named branch at the identical bundle SHA. Treat as environment/posture, not a source defect.

C1-W7: A gate-harness PowerShell cleanup defect deleted disposable gate-owned checkouts; both repositories were re-cloned at the exact frozen SHAs and preflight/source-integrity checks were repeated successfully. Preserve this as process-hygiene history.
